newsitem.title: USA: Pension funds to boost real estate holdings - survey.
newsitem.headline: Pension funds to boost real estate holdings - survey.

text.p: Pension fund managers are expected to boost their real estate investments in the next 12 months, according to a survey by Greystone Realty Corp.

The survey of 21 of the top 50 public and private funds found they will hike the current median asset allocation to seven percent real estate from six percent. The allocation was 5.75 percent a year ago.
According to Greystone, about $2 billion in new cash will be spent on real estate, and assuming that the trend extends to the top 200 funds, the investment is likely to total about $5 billion.
